name: What is the difference between contractor-supplied and homeowner-supplied bathroom fixtures?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between contractor-supplied and homeowner-supplied bathroom fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: When AKN Design Group supplies bathroom fixtures, we leverage our experience and relationships to source high-quality, durable products that fit seamlessly with your renovation plan, ensuring they meet our craftsmanship standards and arrive on schedule. If a homeowner supplies fixtures, it requires careful coordination of delivery timelines and verification that the selected products are compatible with the design and plumbing requirements. While we can install homeowner-provided fixtures, our integrated design-build process offers the most seamless experience when we manage the entire material procurement, guaranteeing optimal quality and project flow for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractor-supplied fixtures ensure quality, compatibility, and timely delivery, while homeowner-supplied ones require careful coordination to avoid project delays.
